what: Actual paired vendor manifests are not opted into fallback_group
scenario_or_breakage: The new dispatcher path is disabled for existing paired Cursor/Codex slots, so duplicate Codex work still launches after this PR
suggested_fix: Add fallback_group to paired cursor/codex rows for each shared archetype and cover at least one real caller fixture

what: Plan does not ledger phase-1 OK grouped results before phase-2 decisions
scenario_or_breakage: If the Codex sibling succeeds in phase 1 and the Cursor sibling fails, the Cursor slot still launches a Codex phase-2 fallback instead of reusing the existing Codex output
suggested_fix: Write ledger rows for every OK grouped result from each collected phase before building or launching the next phase

what: Phase-2 fallbacks are launched as a batch before any phase-2 result is collected
scenario_or_breakage: Two same-group slots that both need Codex fallback will both launch Codex because the second launch cannot see the first fallback success yet
suggested_fix: Serialize grouped phase-2 fallback decisions per group/tool or collect and ledger each grouped fallback before launching the next peer

what: The proposed linter rule cannot see variable-mediated dispatch-with-waterfall invocations
scenario_or_breakage: Real callers resolve dispatch-with-waterfall.sh into variables and later invoke "$DISPATCH_WATERFALL" or "$DISPATCH_SH", so basename-only anchor scanning will miss the actual callsites
suggested_fix: Track variable assignments to the child path and treat later variable command invocations as checked callsites, or require direct calls and update callers

what: New TSV ledger fields lack validation or escaping
scenario_or_breakage: A fallback_group, slot name, or output path containing tabs or newlines can corrupt waterfall-group-results.tsv and produce incorrect reuse decisions
suggested_fix: Reject tab CR LF in fallback_group and ledgered identifiers/paths, or use JSONL for the ledger instead of raw TSV
